skill.name: designing-architecture
skill.description: Designs software architecture and selects appropriate patterns for projects. Use when designing systems, choosing architecture patterns, structuring projects, making technical decisions, or when asked about microservices, monoliths, or architectural approaches.
skill.summary: Guides architecture pattern selection, project structure, and trade-off documentation.
skill.author: CloudAI-X

content.value_statement: Architecture choices shape delivery speed, maintainability, and scale. This skill guides pattern selection, project structure, and decision documentation.
actual_capabilities: Guides architecture pattern selection by project size and team size.
Compares layered, clean, hexagonal, event-driven, and CQRS patterns.
Suggests feature-based and layer-based source directory structures.
Provides an architecture decision workflow and validation checklist.
Helps document trade-offs with a decision record template.
limitations: Does not inspect running systems unless the agent reads project files.
Does not perform formal threat modeling or capacity planning.
Recommendations are generic and need engineering review.
Does not produce detailed deployment diagrams by default.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Service
use_cases.description: Choose an architecture pattern and directory structure before implementation begins.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Monolith Boundaries
use_cases.description: Compare modular monolith and microservice options for a growing product team.

use_cases.title: Document a Technical Decision
use_cases.description: Create a clear decision record that explains options, trade-offs, and consequences.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Starter Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose an architecture for a small application. Ask about requirements, team size, project size, and expected growth.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Architecture Patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare layered, clean, hexagonal, event-driven, and CQRS patterns for my project. Explain the best fit and main trade-offs.

prompt_templates.title: Design Project Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a source directory structure for a medium application with users, orders, and reporting features. Include module boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Write a Decision Record
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an architecture decision record for choosing between a modular monolith and microservices. Include context, options, trade-offs, decision, and consequences.

output_examples.input: A three-person team is building a small CRUD product.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends a simple layered architecture with clear modules, because it supports fast delivery and low operational complexity.

output_examples.input: A growing product has complex business logic and needs better testability.
output_examples.output: The skill suggests clean architecture or hexagonal architecture, then explains dependency direction, adapters, and testing benefits.

output_examples.input: A team wants to split a monolith into services.
output_examples.output: The skill asks for scale and team constraints, then compares modular monolith and microservices before documenting the trade-offs.

best_practices: Provide project size, team size, domain complexity, and growth expectations.
Ask for trade-offs before selecting a pattern.
Record each major architecture choice with context and consequences.
anti_patterns: Do not choose microservices only because the project may grow.
Do not ignore team skills when selecting an architecture.
Do not create layers or modules without clear ownership boundaries.

faq.question: Can this skill choose between monoliths and microservices?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares project size, team capacity, complexity, and scale needs before recommending an approach.

faq.question: Does it generate source code?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on architecture guidance, structure, trade-offs, and decision documentation.

faq.question: Can it help with clean architecture?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains clean architecture layers, dependency direction, and cases where the pattern is useful.

faq.question: Is it useful for small projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It often recommends simple layered designs when complexity is low.

faq.question: Does it replace an architect review?
faq.answer: No. It provides structured guidance that engineers should validate against real constraints.

faq.question: Can it write architecture decision records?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a template for context, options, trade-offs, decisions, and consequences.
